searchText: Why not put it much further than 3 months out instead of moving it every 3 months? It's starting to look kinda stupid at this stage. Because we *should* be exercising the release process frequently. Even if it is just a simple "push back the ice age", it still is valuable to exercise the release process. Also, we want the bomb to go off pretty close after The Merge if possible. When is Merge 🤘
